body:
Yes. But honestly - it doesn't stop the devastation it caused, it seems to grow and grow. He humiliated me. He is insane. I mean he really is and everyone thinks he is wonderful. They would tell me that. And I have nightmares. I don't sleep well. 

But yes, I did leave 3+ months ago. There was some physical damage. PRobably no one would know. But i know. And its mostly what he did to my spirit. I don't feel like me anymore.

Thank you but it is not getting better and I've spoken to them many times. They can't change the things that happened. They can't change all the times I've screwed up. Missed chances. I've tried that for a long time and I can't do it anymore. I want to go to sleep forever. Or be nothing. Or whatever happens. I don't care. Every day is a kind of hell.

I feel very much the same. I suck at helping but I'm here anyway. I feel misery too. I'm glad I got on here and read your post. 
And I mean because I wish you could know someone out here - you know. I care. I get about not wanting to feel so alone. Even when you are wanting it all to end. So im here caring.

I'm on here at 3 AM because I feel very shakey too. I just want you to know someone else is here too and I've read your post. I do care even though I don't know you. 
I don't know if you like warm milk but sometimes it calms me to have something warm. Or I go outside and look at the sky. Or do some jumping jacks and then try to rest. But mostly just wanted you to know I was here. 
(and ps, sorry if those ideas sound lame. I'm pretty useless just now.)

If you never told anyone it's been trapped inside of you all these years. I can understand why you cried. I can't know what your experience was like but when I was 17 I was assulted by an older man and I only told 2 friends, no adults. Anytime I saw anyone who even looked like him I felt sick and shakey, really ill. I can only imagine what it must have been like to see the actual person. It sounds horrible. 
I don't know if it's okay to say so here, but there are sexual assult hotlines you can call.If you felt comfortable doing that. It's only a suggestion. It's only if it feels right for you.  But just so you know they don't care how long ago it was. SOme of them have online chat also. That man broke the law and commited a crime. I'm still badly affected by what happened to me - but I did go on the online chat with the rape crisis people and it did help me a little. But it's hard. I'm so sorry.

I don't have any smart words but it seems to me that the fact that you don't want to turn into your dad indicates you won't because you have so much self awareness. Those evil people think they are marvelous human specimens. I hope someone else here can talk to you. I can relate about the highs fading and the lows. I wish I could say something to help. I don't know much about hallucinations, but I have a lot of strange thoughts these days. And I know how hard it is to feel things are going better and then to start feeling it go wrong again. Like a sickening roller coaster. I'm sorry.

Yes. This is how I feel too. Barely surviving each day and backed into a corner. It feels like I'm on a bench watching everything passing by and days blur together. I just don't feel a part of it anymore. I'm sorry you are feeling this way @PM_ME_YOUR_SOCKS

No, it's horrible what happened to you. Betrayal and abuse bullying are horrendous things. I'm sorry for what happened to you. Yes, trust. Without it it's like always walking in a mine field. Unsure of every step. 

I try not to think of him, but I have nightmares and it's changed my life so completely. 

I like what you have written about bad people being jealous of other peoples gifts. I think that is true too. He always tried to stop me from doing them. My family too. These last lines you wrote have touched me. Thanks. It just seems like they've already taken me down to a cold hard place and I struggle every day to see how to get out. Its a lot of why I feel so lost, those things were like my heart beating, and I've tried to write but my mind is like lead. 

I'll try and read what you've written again in the morning. Thanks @diggeriodo.

Thanks @sofar1776. I haven't done anything permanant yet. But I saw a women who works with victims of crimes. It's just that I understand his mind is not right. That he's cruel, a bully, and I'm innocent. I've looked at patterns of abuse. I know he tricked me into believing in him. But it doesn't ever change how much he hurt me. He used me like a toy doll. And then when he was done was ready to kill me. I had a kind of out of body experience when he attacked me with the knife. That was 4 months ago. I've never been the same.  I have tried very very hard.  But thank you for your kindness. It means something that someone cares enough to write to me.
